PR3. {[int], :false} | {[int], :true} and {[int], :false | :true} intern apart (named still-broken at set-theoretic-types.md ~150 and canon_test.rs ~420). Move canon's widen_rects/next_widening (canon.rs ~512-547, on emptiness::phi_tuple) into intern and fold with normalize_tuple_coordinate_differences into one tuple normalizer; add the exact product merge {A,C} ∨ {B,C} = {A∨B, C}, which turns a ladder's width growth into pure depth growth and is the form the μ fold recognizes. Delete Coord::Widened, split_rects and the canon-side widening. Test: two_carvings_of_one_tuple_union_intern_once with that witness. Expect a backend-inventory re-pin (canon_test.rs ~539) with its measured cause, folds never raise a count.
